description: Clock divider with eight outputs, each dividing the clock by a number taken from a table of integers, even numbers, odd numbers, primes, powers of two, random chances or an eight-step rotation

params.text: Picks the table of division numbers: integers 2 to 9, even 2 to 16, odd 3 to 17, primes 2 to 19, binary 2 to 256, random, or an eight-step rotation
Each press steps the output shape on: gate holds until the next clock, trig gives a 1ms pulse, gate2 holds for half the division cycle, and as is copies the pulse width of the clock
Musical fires each output on the first clock of its division cycle and math on the last; the random and sequential tables are unaffected by it

inputs.text: Advances the count on a rising edge, reading high at 1V and low again at 0.5V
A rising edge sets the count back to zero, so every output begins its cycle again

outputs.text: Carries 10V when the count reaches the number printed against it; in random mode it fires with a chance of one in that number, and in sequential mode on its own step of an eight-step rotation

notes: Nothing runs on its own: every output stays at 0V until the first rising edge arrives at the clock input, and the count begins from that edge
